Gold before the jobs report: beyond the Fed's target range

Treasury's nominal yield fell 5 basis points on November 4. Its real yield fell 1. Gold's jobs-report watch needs both.

https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/gold-before-the-jobs-report-beyond

Watch: A sustained real-yield rise after the jobs report would weaken this particular support for gold.

Analysis, not financial advice.

Readers decide whether to trade.

Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
